blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Code can choose. A condition is a question that is True or False. `if` runs a block only when the condition is True.

blocks.title: if, elif, else
Combining
items: `a or b`: at least one True

blocks.body: `=` stores, `==` compares. Every `if`, `elif` and `else` line ends with a colon.
